Package org.praxisplatform.uischema.annotation

Enum Class LegalTreatmentPurpose

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<LegalTreatmentPurpose>
org.praxisplatform.uischema.annotation.LegalTreatmentPurpose
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<LegalTreatmentPurpose>, Constable
public enum LegalTreatmentPurpose extends Enum<LegalTreatmentPurpose>
Canonical legal treatment purposes for semantic surfaces (UiSurface) and governed workflow commands (WorkflowAction).

Binds an operational read projection or business command to an explicit treatment finality (such as LGPD Art. 7 / Art. 11, statutory public-administration obligations, official health expertise, or active public transparency under LAI), enabling deterministic policy engines, audit trails, and semantic catalogs to verify purpose compatibility before exposing or mutating governed data.
